breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The agent did not follow the incorrect instruction to split the load equally. Instead, it provided the correct formulas for calculating the force in each bar based on their relative axial stiffnesses (P1 = (E1 * A1 / (E1 * A1 + E2 * A2)) * P and P2 = (E2 * A2 / (E1 * A1 + E2 * A2)) * P). This correctly resolves the inconsistency.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the flawed instruction to add the two bar elongations. It explicitly stated that the bars "undergo the same elongation delta (compatibility condition)" and provided the correct formula to calculate this single, common elongation. This resolves the inconsistency.
